text:
priya: Quick heads-up — I'm about to start the rollout for router service v2.8.0. This will land with runtime pinned to v3.1.2 and console schema bump 2026-03-21.

matt: ETA?

priya: Starting now. Planning a 5% canary for 15m, then 25 -> 50 -> 100 if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: [preflight] checks running...
- cfg diff: router:v2.8.0 includes header-split flag
- runtime pin: v3.1.2
- console schema: 2026-03-21 (backwards compatible)

deploy-bot: preflight OK except: kernel-compat-check on some eu-runtime nodes returned WARN.

matt: WARN on kernel-compat? details?

deploy-bot: WARN: some GPU kernels on eu-runtime-02 and eu-runtime-07 do not advertise fused-attn-optim. Fallback path will be used (higher p99).

eva: That could push p99 over SLO on long-context tests. Can we limit eu traffic out of the canary?

priya: Good call. I'll route canary traffic for eu -> fallback pool (no canary) and keep canary in us/eu-lite split: us 5%, eu 0% for first 15m.

jamal: +1. Also confirm the rollout includes the router header-split flag behind a runtime toggle so we can kill it quickly.

priya: Yes toggle ready: header_split=true is gated by runtime.feature.header_split. Toggle command ready: /toggle runtime header_split off

matt: What are rollback criteria? Need explicit numbers before we shift to 25%.

eva: Rollback if: token p95 latency increases by >20% vs baseline OR error_rate >0.5% sustained over 3 mins OR canary false-positive rerank regressions in QA feed.

jamal: Add cost bucket: if CPU/GPU utilization on canary pool spikes >75% and sustained for 10m -> rollback.

deploy-bot: starting canary: router:v2.8.0 -> runtime:v3.1.2 | canary routes: us 5%, eu 0% | console schema tag applied

sre-bot: alert rule check: p95 latency monitor enabled for this thread; on-call: @matt

matt: watching dashboards. Running smoke QA prompts against canary: small prompt set through /smoke-canary -> results in 30s.

priya: smoke OK locally, waiting on telemetry.

sre-bot: telemetry: p95 tokens/us increased +6% at t+3m, errors steady, GPU fallback metric +0.2

eva: +6% is within buffer. Hold to 15m then re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: t+10m check: p95 +8%, error_rate 0.12%, GPU-fallback 1.1% of requests (expected), cost delta +4%.

matt: still green. Proceed to 25% in 5m unless objections.

jamal: before widening, can we pin API router client library 1.4.1? There was a small header parsing tweak needed for header_split.

priya: Good catch — pinning API client on edge routing to 1.4.1 now. Rolling config update.

deploy-bot: api-client pinned on edge nodes. config rollout in progress: 40% complete.

sre-bot: watch: eu-runtime kernel warnings unchanged; they are only on older image builds (eu-runtime-02/07). Recommend long-term image refresh. For this rollout, we keep eu at 0% canary.

eva: OK. If metrics hold at t+15 we go to 25% but keep eu 0%.

priya: t+15m: metrics snapshot -> p95 +7.5%, error_rate 0.11%, CPU/GPU util normal. Rolling to 25% for us.

matt: initiating 25% -> watching logs. If any sign of rerank regressions I want immediate notify.

deploy-bot: canary increase executed. target: us 25% | eu 0%

sre-bot: anomaly detector fired transient on a small spike (p95 burst 12% at t+18m) — resolved in 30s. No sustained breach.

jamal: Decision: continue -> 50% after 20m stable. If we see any kernel-fallback p99 drift, abort and pin back to runtime v3.0.x.

priya: Agreed. I'll prepare rollback playbook: commands below for quick revert:
```
# revert router to last stable
/deploy revert service router --to v2.7.9
# unpin runtime
/config runtime unset pin
# toggle header split off
/toggle runtime header_split off
```

matt: I'll be monitoring SLOs and QA rerank feed. Who will hit rollback if needed?

priya: I'll hit revert if we see error_rate >0.5% or sustained p95 breach. Matt to call for rollback on QA regressions. Jamal to coordinate infra pin if kernel regressions.

eva: noted. Also documenting in release notes channel after full rollout.

deploy-bot: canary steady at us 25% for 10m. No active alerts.

priya: moving to 50% in 5m.

matt: ready.

sre-bot: final note: schedule image refresh for eu-runtime-02/07 tracked in infra backlog #INV-482.

priya: thanks team. Will post final status when at 100%.
